name: Hero-Hime
source:
"STARLIGHT SMASH!" Hero-Hime is the protagonist of Starlight Overheaders! Hero-Hime is energetic, goofy, and overly positive in an endearing way, or at least, that's what the animators hoped. She carries her magic tennis racket, which invokes her transformation between sports hero and avarage college student. Her goal is to become the TENNISTAR - the best tennis player and hero of Heart Ace Academy. Hero-Hime trains diligently every day in order to achieve her goal. She's an underdog, after all, and she knows.
Likes: Tangerines, Cake, Tennis Practice
Dislikes: Giving 50-99%

[From the in-game Date-a-dex]
